verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents designer-built reusable components with variants, or per-instance overrides that stay linked to a source component. The closest items are developer building blocks or passing mentions: Code Components are custom React components, Code Overrides are higher-order components written in code, and other docs only mention 'components' in AI-refinement or agent-access contexts. None of these establishes the story's capability.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to their source
